title: Independent coordinate noise kernel
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. Define a probability distribution on $\{\pm1\}^n$ by independently applying the coordinate sign noise distribution, with parameter $\rho$, to each coordinate of $x$.
caveat: The exact coordinate keep probability is not defined in the supplied snippet.
